# Knowledge-Core-Web: Workflows

## `workflows.development`

Status: `verified`

- **npm:dev**: `{"command":"next dev","source":"package.json"}`
- **npm:start**: `{"command":"next start","source":"package.json"}`

Sources: `detected:project-scripts`, `package.json`, `user-confirmed`, `user-confirmed-development-commands`

There is no `.github/workflows/ci.yml` / `web-pull-request`. Pushes to `dev` run `.github/workflows/pipeline.yml` from `.ci/pipeline.yaml` on ARC: `verify`/`deploy`/`smoke`/`release` use `hls-standard` (non-privileged containers, request 2 CPU / 1Gi, limit 4 CPU / 4Gi, min 1 max 8; namespace quota 32 CPU / 32Gi, pods 12); `package` uses `hls-builder` (privileged Docker-in-Docker 4 CPU / 4Gi plus runner 4 CPU / 1Gi, min 0 max 8; CPU/memory ResourceQuota stays 64 CPU / 40Gi, pods 10). Workflow `max-parallel` is 8. `web-verify-build` runs lint, typecheck, test, build, Playwright e2e, and Storybook. The standard namespace is Pod Security privileged only so runners can share hostPath `/var/lib/hls-ci-cache` at `/cache`; GitHub Actions cache is not used. External HTTP(S) uses `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`=`http://10.42.0.1:10991` from the `arc-proxy` Secret; `NO_PROXY` covers localhost, loopbacks, `.svc`, the Kubernetes API, Harbor, Argo, and `.happyladysauce.local`. `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` remains so Node 24 actions including `create-github-app-token` post honor that proxy. Node/pnpm/Playwright downloads use npmmirror (`cdn.npmmirror.com` / `registry.npmmirror.com`) and do not restore GitHub Actions package caches. Playwright CI `webServer.timeout` is 180s with `PORT=3000` and `HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0`. `prewarm-base-images` needs only `plan` so it runs beside `web-verify-build`. `deploy-release` checkouts use `fetch-depth: 0` so `origin/main` ancestry checks succeed. Knowledge-Core-Web/deploy is the editable deployment source and CI synchronizes it automatically to HappyLadySauceM/deploy/Knowledge-Core-Web using the `knowledge-core-web-release` ServiceAccount and in-cluster `https://kubernetes.default.svc:443`; deploy-only changes skip image builds while still validating the overlay, updating GitOps, waiting for Argo, running smoke, and promoting main. Harbor tags candidates by commit SHA, then promotes `:dev` and updates `:previous` after smoke. Failures support rollback, and force-push is forbidden. The `release` environment is limited to `dev` and supplies GH App credentials, kubeconfig, and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. `pipeline.yml` ends with an `if: always()` `notify` job on `hls-standard` that posts a CI Feishu card. Independent `.github/workflows/feishu-notify.yml` posts pull_request, pull_request_review, issues, issue_comment, and release events only (no `workflow_run` or `push`) through HappyLadySauceM/ci-templates `.github/actions/feishu-notify` using organization secrets `FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL` and `FEISHU_WEBHOOK_SECRET`; it does not use the `release` environment, and a notify failure does not fail `knowledge-core-web-pipeline`.
